name: 66762 · Pittsburg, KS
findings: ZIP 66762 (Pittsburg) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66762 (Pittsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66762 (Pittsburg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
